purpose: Execute the atomic resolve-body-semantically operation within the MA-28 boundary: Root-only semantic body resolver. Supported criteria are name as an optional filter, plus bbox_mm and/or volume_mm3; name alone is rejected. The action does not mutate geometry.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires resolve-body-semantically and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.description: Optional name filter plus at least one geometric criterion: bbox_mm or volume_mm3.

preconditions: criteria contains bbox_mm or volume_mm3; name alone is insufficient.
Criteria values and any used tolerances are finite and structurally valid.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique current root-part body matching the supported geometric criteria.

postconditions: Exactly one current root DesignBody matches all supplied filters; one(...) returns it.
